status: Closed — Fixed in 7e9c5f784; runner publication cecc61d1a verified 2026-09-06
finding: `taskflow close` stages the whole planning task-card file when writing closure frontmatter. If the same physical card file also contains an unrelated in-flight planning edit, the close commit can forcibly include that edit because there is no partial-stage or field-scoped closeback path.
expectedBehavior: Planning closeback should stage only the closure mutation or provide a governed split/reconcile path when a physical planning card has unrelated dirty hunks. It should fail with a precise diagnostic rather than silently coupling close metadata with unrelated planning changes.
evidenceOrRepro: Red reproduction in tests/cli/taskflow-close-planning-card-partial-stage.test.ts showed closeback had no partial staging snapshot while unrelated frontmatter/body WIP coexisted. Commit 7e9c5f784 adds a HEAD-based partial planning-card staging payload and stages it through the isolated temporary index; focused regression, closeback regression, typecheck, CLI surface, and encoding guard passed. Frozen runner publication cecc61d1a was rebuilt and pushed; node atm.mjs --version reports syncRequired=false.
followUp: Formal task-card closeout remains separate from this backlog closure. Continue auditing other backlog items; do not treat this quickfix as completion of a broader plan.
